name: zinput_mouse_is_unsuspended
description: zInput::Mouse_IsUnsuspended reports whether the mouse suspend flag is clear.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation validates this no-callee leaf reads the mouse suspend flag and returns 1 only when the suspend bit is clear.
The native smoke verifies the unsuspended and suspended states for mouse, joystick, and keyboard suspend flags.
